uci_water_treatment.label: synthetic
uci_water_treatment.protocol: Synthetic anomalies are injected only in the test segment after the reference period. Point anomalies are 3.5–6 reference standard deviations; short drifts are 4 consecutive points at 2.5 standard deviations. The Z-score threshold and Isolation Forest contamination are preset and are not chosen on the test labels. Random Forest is trained on a separate set of training synthetic labels, and its decision threshold is chosen by F1 on that training set only.
